field_edits.updated_text: The adjacent humeral cortex is intact with no cortical erosion, destruction, remodeling, or abnormal marrow signal. No acute osseous abnormality is identified. No aggressive bone lesion.
Visualized surrounding musculature is preserved without edema or abnormal signal.

Well-defined elongated fat‑containing lesion in the intermuscular plane at the level of the mid shaft of the left humerus, measuring approximately 56 × 20 × 82 mm (transverse × AP × craniocaudal). The lesion is T1 hyperintense with signal loss on STIR, consistent with macroscopic fat. No suspicious internal nodular component or non‑fatty signal is seen. No significant adjacent soft‑tissue edema or fluid collection.

impression:
1. Well‑defined intermuscular macroscopic fat‑containing lesion along the mid shaft of the left humerus, measuring approximately 56 × 20 × 82 mm, most consistent with an intramuscular/intermuscular lipoma.
2. No cortical destruction, bone erosion, marrow involvement, cortical remodeling, or aggressive imaging features; no acute osseous abnormality.
